lines.zh: 轻捷地走过草地，偶尔停下来寻找美味的蘑菇。
lines.en: Swiftly stepping on the grass, occasionally pausing to seek tasty mushrooms.

lines.zh: 在林间穿梭，注意着周围的动静。
lines.en: Moving through the forest, paying attention to the surroundings.

lines.zh: 穿越灌木丛，寻找新地点定居。
lines.en: Passing through the bushes, searching for a new settlement.

lines.zh: 从远处走过，偶尔发出低沉的鸣叫。
lines.en: Walking from afar, occasionally making a low call.

lines.zh: 走过村庄边缘，寻找食物和水源。
lines.en: Passing by the village edge, searching for food and water.

lines.zh: 经过玩家，好奇地打量一番。
lines.en: Passing by the player, curiously inspecting.

lines.zh: 轻快地在树林里穿行，寻找新的家园。
lines.en: Swiftly moving through the forest, searching for a new home.

lines.zh: 走过花丛，享受着温暖的阳光。
lines.en: Walking through the flower beds, basking in the warm sunlight.

lines.zh: 从树荫下穿过，享受着清凉。
lines.en: Passing through the shade, enjoying the coolness.

lines.zh: 在田野上漫步，寻找新鲜的草籽。
lines.en: Walking in the fields, searching for fresh seeds.
The Ehu trots softly over fallen leaves.
It runs past with a mushroom in its mouth.
Its tail sweeps the roadside grass.
It skirts a puddle with a hop.

lines.zh: 悠闲地吃着手中新鲜的蘑菇。
lines.en: Eating fresh mushrooms in hand leisurely.

lines.zh: 坐在草地上，享受片刻宁静。
lines.en: Sitting on the grass, enjoying a moment of peace.

lines.zh: 在林间休息，打量周围的环境。
lines.en: Resting in the forest, inspecting the surroundings.

lines.zh: 悠闲地在湖边散步，享受着宁静。
lines.en: Walking by the lake, enjoying the tranquility.

lines.zh: 在村庄里闲逛，寻找新的交易机会。
lines.en: Strolling in the village, seeking new trading opportunities.

lines.zh: 在阳光下打盹，享受片刻宁静。
lines.en: Dozing in the sun, enjoying a moment of peace.

lines.zh: 在田野上漫步，享受着清风。
lines.en: Walking in the fields, enjoying the breeze.

lines.zh: 悠闲地啃着草，享受着自然。
lines.en: Chewing on grass, enjoying nature.

lines.zh: 在树荫下打盹，享受着凉爽。
lines.en: Dozing in the shade, enjoying the coolness.

lines.zh: 在湖边喝水，享受片刻宁静。
lines.en: Drinking by the lake, enjoying a moment of peace.
The Ehu hides a mushroom under leaves.
It pricks its ears to the wind.
It curls into a ball and dozes.
It licks its own forepaw.

lines.zh: 好奇地盯着玩家，似乎有所期待。
lines.en: Curiously staring at the player, as if expecting something.

lines.zh: 轻盈地靠近，准备进行交易。
lines.en: Gracefully approaching, ready to trade.

lines.zh: 在玩家周围徘徊，寻求交易机会。
lines.en: Roaming around the player, seeking trading opportunities.

lines.zh: 注意玩家，准备交易一些物品。
lines.en: Noticing the player, preparing to trade some items.

lines.zh: 靠近玩家，准备进行对话。
lines.en: Approaching the player, ready to converse.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，似乎在等待命令。
lines.en: Staring at the player, as if waiting for a command.

lines.zh: 轻盈地靠近玩家，准备进行交易。
lines.en: Gracefully approaching the player, ready to trade.

lines.zh: 在玩家附近徘徊，寻求交易。
lines.en: Roaming around the player, seeking a trade.

lines.zh: 靠近玩家，准备交易一些货物。
lines.en: Approaching the player, ready to trade some goods.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，准备进行对话和交易。
lines.en: Staring at the player, ready for both conversation and trade.
The Ehu sniffs your boots.
It tips its head to one side.
It circles you halfway.
It eyes the pouch at your belt.
It brushes you with its tail.
Did it hear the bell you carry?
It steps back, then forward again.
Its ears flatten back a little.
It stops at your feet and waits.
It dips its head in a small bow.
Ouch, that hurts!
The bones are so fragile...
Be careful, don't touch my wound!
I'm injured, find the apothecary!
Help me, it hurts so much!
It needs time to heal!
Don't touch me, it hurts!
My fur is hurt...

lines.zh: 我的腿受伤了，走不动了……
lines.en: I have a leg wound, I can't walk...

lines.zh: 我的翅膀受了伤，飞不起来了。
lines.en: My wings are hurt, I can't fly.
Come, taste my fruit!
My fruit has magic!
Don't give up, I have more!

lines.zh: 让我的种子在你手中生根！
lines.en: Let my seed root in your hand!
Share, you can too!
My fruit is the source of life!
Enjoy my fruit together!
Try my fruit!
Let my fruit heal you!
Share and grow together!
Avoid me, my tentacles are hard!
Watch out for my tentacle attack!
Step back, don't touch me!
Don't get close, I'll反击!
My tentacles can hurt you!
Be careful, my tentacles are dangerous!
Stay away from me, protect yourself!
My tentacles are not toys!
You've squeezed my egg sac.
Step back, my tentacles are dangerous!

lines.zh: 找到伴侣，我们才能繁殖！
lines.en: Find a mate, we can reproduce!

lines.zh: 寻找我的同类，我们共生！
lines.en: Find my kind, we coexist!

lines.zh: 让爱的种子在我们之间播撒！
lines.en: Let the seed of love be sown between us!

lines.zh: 找到另一半，我们才能繁殖！
lines.en: Find your partner, we can reproduce!

lines.zh: 共同繁殖，我们的种族才能延续！
lines.en: Reproduce together, our species will continue!

lines.zh: 找到配偶，我们才能繁殖！
lines.en: Find a mate, we can reproduce!

lines.zh: 我的卵需要温暖的环境！
lines.en: My eggs need a warm environment!

lines.zh: 找到我的同类，我们才能繁殖！
lines.en: Find my kind, we can reproduce!
My antennae brush against you first.

lines.zh: 找到我的伴侣，我们才能繁殖！
lines.en: Find my mate, we can reproduce!

lines.zh: 伊狐轻盈跳过，发出悦耳铃声。
lines.en: Ehu hops by, ringing melodiously.

lines.zh: 伊狐的叫声如清风拂过。
lines.en: Ehu’s call is like a gentle breeze.
Ehu munches on tender grass leaves.

lines.zh: 伊狐在阳光下打盹，好梦。
lines.en: Ehu naps in the sun, sweet dreams.

lines.zh: 伊狐发现食物，欢快地奔跑。
lines.en: Ehu runs happily, spotting food.
Ehu cools off under the tree shade.

lines.zh: 伊狐围着你转圈，求食物。
lines.en: Ehu circles around you, begging for food.

lines.zh: 伊狐在河边喝水，咕咚咕咚。
lines.en: Ehu drinks water by the river, gulping loudly.
Ehu makes contented calls.
Ehu sleeps in a tree洞.

lines.zh: 伊狐注意到你，眼睛瞪大。
lines.en: Ehu notices you, eyes widening.
Ehu cautiously circles you.
Ehu jumps near you.
Ehu sniffs the air cautiously.
Ehu listens with its ears.
Ehu moves around you.

lines.zh: 伊狐注意到了潜在威胁。
lines.en: Ehu notices a potential threat.
Ehu fixes you with a wary stare.
Ehu starts to guard you.

lines.zh: 伊狐向你投来好奇的目光。
lines.en: Ehu gives you a curious look.
Ehu starts targeting you.
Ehu locks on to you.
Ehu prepares to attack you.
Ehu attacks you.
Ehu's attack is lightning fast.
Ehu claws at you.
Ehu bites you.
Ehu gives an attack warning.

lines.zh: 伊狐试图用攻击吓退你。
lines.en: Ehu tries to scare you with its attack.
Ehu swipes at you with its tail.

lines.zh: 咆哮一声，利爪撕裂空气。
lines.en: Roar, claws slice the air.

lines.zh: 扑向敌人，利牙闪烁光芒。
lines.en: Leap at the enemy, fangs gleam.

lines.zh: 用坚硬的爪子抓向对手。
lines.en: Scratch with hard claws.

lines.zh: 狂奔而来，掀起地面尘土。
lines.en: Charge, kicking up dirt.
Tack down, bite firmly.
Swing claws, send them flying.
Roar and扑向猎物.
Bite, and hold tight.
Swing claws, attack all.
Charge, scratch with claws.
Sssss and appear.

lines.zh: 从地下冒出来，嘶嘶叫着。
lines.en: Pop up and hiss.

lines.zh: 从裂缝中爬出，嘶嘶叫着。
lines.en: Crawl out of a crack, hiss.
Sssss and appear at night.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶叫着从洞穴中走出。
lines.en: Sssss and walk out of a cave.
Sssss and appear from the dark.

lines.zh: 从石缝中嘶嘶叫着爬出。
lines.en: Sssss and crawl out of the stone.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶叫着出现在地面上。
lines.en: Sssss and appear on the ground.

lines.zh: 从阴影中嘶嘶叫着出现。
lines.en: Sssss and appear from the shadows.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶叫着从土堆中爬出。
lines.en: Sssss and crawl out of the dirt.
Fire burned me!
Fell out of a tree!
Water up my nose!
The blast knocked me over!
An arrow nicked my ear!
Magic makes me shiver!
My antennae droop and I wobble.
Lightning singed my fur!
I'm falling through the void!
